title: UPERFECT GR19BU Review: Stunning 4K Visuals in a Travel-Friendly Design - NewsBreak
text:
By Justin Goodrum ,
4 hours ago
If you're looking for a portable monitor that strikes a balance between compact size and premium performance, the UPERFECT GR19BU 19-inch 4K UHD Gaming Monitor is a compelling option. Its 19-inch display offers more screen space than ultra-portable models while remaining easy to carry for work or gaming on the go. Priced at $539.99 USD, the GR19BU sits in the premium category, but its feature set rivals that of more expensive portable displays. For users willing to invest in a high-end portable monitor, the GR19BU delivers impressive performance and strong overall value.
What’s in the Box? Once unboxed, you’ll see the 19" portable monitor, 1 mini HDMI Cable(4K), 2 Type-C to Type-C cables, 1 PD 30W power charger, and a user manual.
Feature Set For professionals and gamers who want a desktop-like experience away from home, the UPERFECT GR19BU packs flagship features into a portable design. The 19-inch display combines a 3840 x 2160 (4K UHD) resolution with a 144Hz refresh rate, making it well-suited for gaming, video editing, and multitasking. To achieve peak brightness and performance, UPERFECT recommends using a 30W or higher USB-C power source.
The monitor's QLED panel delivers vibrant visuals with 146% sRGB color coverage, 500 nits of brightness, a 2,000:1 contrast ratio and HDR support.
Gamers will also appreciate the monitor's 0.1ms response time, which minimizes motion blur and ghosting for smoother gameplay and sharper visuals during fast-paced action such as first-person shooters.
For added flexibility, the GR19BU supports 75 x 75mm VESA mounting, and its adjustable stand tilts up to 180 degrees to accommodate a variety of viewing angles. Connectivity includes USB-C and HDMI, making the monitor compatible with PCs, MacBooks, tablets, smartphones, PlayStation 5, Xbox and Nintendo Switch.
To take full advantage of the monitor's 4K resolution at 144Hz, your device and cable must support HDMI 2.1 (28.66 Gbps or higher) or USB-C with DisplayPort 1.4 Alt Mode. Without that hardware support, the display will operate at lower refresh rates or resolutions.
Real Life Testing Most people who buy a new piece of tech want to start using it right away, not spend time tweaking settings to get the picture just right. The UPERFECT GR19BU delivers on that expectation. Simply plug it in, and it produces a sharp, vibrant image with little need for adjustment.
UPERFECT has built a reputation for portable monitors, and the GR19BU continues that trend. The 19-inch display reaches up to 500 nits of brightness, making it easy to use in a variety of lighting conditions. Colors are vivid, black levels are solid and overall image quality is impressive. My only complaint is the HDR mode. It produced blown-out highlights that made the image look unnatural, so I preferred leaving HDR turned off.
Gaming is where the GR19BU really shines. The 144 Hz refresh rate delivers smooth gameplay, while AMD FreeSync helps eliminate screen tearing for a fluid experience. This monitor completely changed my perspective on portable gaming. Pairing it with a laptop creates a dual-screen setup that closely mirrors a home office or gaming station, making it a great option for work and play while traveling.
The biggest drawback is the on-screen display menu. The controls are located on the right side, but the button icons are difficult to identify, making navigation more frustrating than it should be. I frequently pressed the wrong button while trying to adjust settings. Once you learn the layout, the experience improves, but there is definitely a learning curve.
The built-in speakers are serviceable for casual use, but they lack the depth and volume needed for an immersive gaming or entertainment experience. For the best audio, you'll want to connect a pair of headphones or external speakers.
Final Verdict If price isn't your primary concern, the UPERFECT GR19BU stands out among portable monitors. Its vibrant colors, wide color gamut and sharp image quality combine to deliver an immersive experience for gaming, productivity and entertainment.
Positives: Great design factor; picture out of the box looks sharp. Despite the size, the monitor can be a second screen for on the go or fit in while working on a desk
Negatives: Menu is not the easiest to navigate. Built-in HDR doesn’t look the best; some pictures look washed out. Speakers are mediocre.
Score: 9.0
GameDaily received a review unit of the GR19BU from UPERFECT for this review.
